comments.author: @susangoslin6089
comments.text: Oregon is so beautiful.  I have lived near the Snake River and the Oregon coast.  The Columbia River Gorge has been the source of many memories for me. I have lived in several states, but mostly in Oregon. The old-growth forests are otherworldly.  I love it here.  Cross the middle of the state from Florence on the coast, to Vale, nearly to Idaho, to see the high desert.  I also lived at the base of Mt. Tabor, in Portland.  The city isn't what it used to be, but the setting is still lovely. Thank you for letting me go to familiar places from my living room on the South Coast.

replies.author: @TruePlanetOffical
replies.text:
Thank you for sharing this. You’ve experienced Oregon in a way most visitors never will, from the coast and Columbia River Gorge to the high desert and old-growth forests. I’m glad the film could bring some of those memories back to you on the South Coast. Comments like this are exactly why we make these documentaries. ❤️

If you enjoyed the journey, please subscribe, like, and share — it truly helps us keep exploring.
